title: Join the Key West Literary Seminar
description: Spend four days in Key West listening to writers and readers explore a shared literary theme. The 2027 seminar centers on poetry, with talks and readings that invite you to hear how a line or image works. Conversations continue between sessions, and the island setting gives you room to think about what you heard.
teaser: Share four days of poetry and conversation in Key West.
goodToKnow: The 2027 poetry seminar runs January 7–10. Reserve admission and lodging early, and check the final program.
whyItMightDelightYou: Hearing writers think aloud can send you back to familiar books with new ears.
